policyObservation: Current primary source-defined quarter candidates can retain historical dates, unverified current extents and unknown affine georeferencing accuracy. Eger must pass individual quarter-versus-site/group/partial scope checks, but does not require coincidence with current ITS polygons, current legal status, or address accuracy when Tata/Esztergom do not.

entries.method: Official statutory PDF filled-vector path extraction; affine georeferencing in EOV(EPSG:23700) against the current Tata municipal boundary; transformed to WGS84. No buffer, residential-extent inference, artificial closing chord, clipping, or arbitrary polygon generation.
entries.license: ODbL-1.0 (OSM-derived georeferencing); official statutory boundary facts
